ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green crumbly granular mass with rough, grainy texture and small tan/golden bits, mounded on the upper-left portion of a white square plate, roughly 9 cm across and 1.5-2 cm tall, dry-looking with no visible sheen | 85
ITEM 2 | Single dark green, glossy, smooth-surfaced leaf (or spinach-like leaf) lying on top of the grainy mound near the top center, about 4 cm long and 2.5 cm wide, thin and flat | 6
ITEM 3 | Shredded pale green and cream-yellow leafy greens with ruffled, crisp-looking edges, scattered across the lower and right side of the plate in a loose heap about 12 cm by 9 cm, 1-2 cm tall, with slight moisture sheen and some pale whitish-yellow tips | 70
ITEM 4 | Thin, flat, off-white to pale yellow shaved flakes with slightly translucent edges, one larger piece about 3 cm across resting on the grainy mound at center-left, plus a few small fragments scattered among the greens, dry and matte | 8
ITEM 5 | Light golden-tan toasted crumbs or small bits with darker edges clustered among the greens and on the mound near the upper right, dry and crisp-looking, scattered over about 4 cm area | 6
